new_capability: Summarize all fixed slots and per-attempt resource records without filtering successful answers or inventing missing usage
key_distinctions: Adapter pending records do not prove completed model inference
Saved provider usage is reported usage, not independently verified model work
Missing or malformed usage remains unknown; reported token sums are partial
Recorded tool charges include failed and pending attempts, but are declared units rather than financial cost
Pending and completed records describe one charge, not two
Historical private backend timing inside cached results is not current cache-read time
Per-action timings, generation callback timings and batch wall time have different scopes and are not added indiscriminately
Startup, hashing, cache preparation, review, backup, idle billing and interrupted in-flight work remain unmeasured here

tests.scope: Synthetic ledgers, temporary local archives and mocked replies; no model or network calls

archived_scripted_check.interpretation: Accounting consistency for archived scripted routes only; no inference about model efficiency or method benefit

scientific_status: Controlled cache-price effects and strong-baseline residual gains remain untested
